geometry: [-20,30]x[-40,40]x[-2,2] minus stationary cylinder x^2+y^2<=0.25, axis z (D=1, span=4D)
boundaries: outlet x=30: convective outlet condition; not replaced by natural traction
initial_condition: uniform incoming stream with no-slip cylinder and a mesh-consistent divergence-free spanwise perturbation before statistical admission; exact source initial transient is not specified; stationary unforced-cylinder statistics only
provenance: Kim et al., JFM1001 A24, DOI10.1017/jfm.2024.1079, stationary-cylinder validation in section2.1/Table1: Re300, span4D, Neumann far field, convective outflow, 200 shedding cycles. Absolute start/end times are project computational budgets; at least200 measured cycles and transient rejection are separate acceptance conditions. Convective outlet/Neumann far-field execution is not currently supported.
